summary: This bill amends the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act to establish a grant program for junior or community colleges and technical schools to expand training, education, and outreach for careers in the residential construction industry, prioritizing entities serving rural areas or underserved populations.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a grant program for training in residential construction, and explicitly requires grant recipients to ensure partners provide fair wages and benefits. It also mandates compliance with all labor laws and requires attestation that recipients are not subject to pending labor law violations. Furthermore, it allows for partnerships with labor organizations. These provisions collectively strengthen labor protections and acknowledge the role of labor organizations, pushing towards more labor laws and union rights.
